summary: Iteration 47: tested the new member-facing Email preferences card on Profile → Notifications + the new GET/PUT /api/me/email-preferences endpoints + per-category resolve_segment filter end-to-end. Backend 12/12 pytest cases pass: (1) GET unauthed → 401; (2) GET as fresh member returns {email_opt_out:false, email_prefs:{blasts:true, dues_reminders:true}}; (3) PUT unauthed → 401; (4) PUT {blasts:false} returns {ok:true, email_opt_out:false, email_prefs:{blasts:false, dues_reminders:true}} and persists in subsequent GET; (5) PUT {email_opt_out:true} flips master kill + writes email_opt_out_at; (6) PUT {blasts:true, dues_reminders:true} after master kill auto-clears email_opt_out (implicit re-subscribe); (7) PUT with email_opt_out:true explicit overrides implicit re-subscribe (still sets opt_out true); (8) /api/auth/me public_user() now exposes both email_opt_out and email_prefs.{blasts,dues_reminders}; (9) blast custom-segment targeting member with email_opt_out=true → 400 'no recipients' (filter works); (10) blast custom-segment targeting member with email_prefs.blasts=false (master OFF) → 400 'no recipients' (per-category filter works); resubscribe + /email/preview returns recipient_count=1; (11+12) static inspection confirms dues-reminder cron mongo query at line 6205-6206 includes both `email_opt_out:{$ne:True}` AND `email_prefs.dues_reminders:{$ne:False}`, and resolve_segment at line 4324-4325 includes `email_prefs.blasts:{$ne:False}`. Frontend: full happy-path verified via Playwright as member@clubhaven.app — /profile → Notifications tab renders [data-testid=email-preferences] with all three toggles (email-prefs-blasts-toggle, email-prefs-dues-toggle, email-prefs-optout-toggle) and [data-testid=email-prefs-save-btn]. Toggling master kill ON + Save shows the green 'Email preferences saved' toast and the amber [data-testid=email-prefs-master-banner] ('You are currently unsubscribed from all marketing email.'). With master kill ON, toggling blasts ON + Save auto-clears the master kill (banner disappears, optout-toggle returns to unchecked, blasts stays checked) — implicit re-subscribe works on the UI as well. Navigating /profile → /dashboard → /profile → Notifications re-fetches via GET /api/me/email-preferences on mount and the saved state {blasts:checked, optout:unchecked, banner:hidden} is preserved. No bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: Implicit re-subscribe logic in PUT /me/email-preferences (server.py:4461) only kicks in when body.email_opt_out is None AND (next_prefs.blasts OR next_prefs.dues_reminders). Edge case: if the user already had blasts=true and PUT comes in with no fields at all, next_prefs.blasts stays True (default) and email_opt_out would auto-clear even though the user didn't change anything. Low-impact (the user is actively saving the prefs page, so this is arguably intentional), but worth noting.

ToggleRow `checked={blasts && !optOut}` is purely visual masking — the underlying `blasts` state retains its true value, which is what the PUT body sends. Good. But the dues toggle has no `onChange` guard like the blasts one (line 769 `if (v) setOptOut(false)` vs line 777 same pattern — actually both are guarded, so this is fine). Confirmed correct.

Profile.jsx EmailPreferences fetches /me/email-preferences in a useEffect with empty deps — works, but if the user mutates email_opt_out elsewhere (e.g., clicks the public Unsubscribe link in another tab) while this card is mounted, it won't refresh until Notifications tab is re-mounted. Minor — not a regression, just FYI.

Carry-over from iter46: FRONTEND_URL in /app/backend/.env still points to the preview host; UNSUBSCRIBE_SECRET is still aliased to JWT_SECRET. Unrelated to iter47 but should be tracked for prod rollout.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (7/7 UI checks across Profile → Notifications card, save toast, banner, implicit re-subscribe, persistence after navigation)

Backend filter clauses: dues cron query at server.py L6205-6206 needs both `email_opt_out:{$ne:True}` AND `email_prefs.dues_reminders:{$ne:False}`; resolve_segment at L4324-4325 needs `email_prefs.blasts:{$ne:False}`. Implicit re-subscribe: PUT without explicit email_opt_out but with any category=true → auto-clears email_opt_out. public_user() now returns email_opt_out + email_prefs in /api/auth/me and member listings.
